item.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
item.description:
Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models.

The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash
item.description:
Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast agentic model with a 1M-token window, 4 thinking levels and $1.50/$7.50 pricing. Google reports a 51 Artificial Analysis score and 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1.

The post Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
item.description:
Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming audio codec that powers LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B. It runs at 12.5 Hz with 12 codebooks and encodes about 361x faster than real time on a single CPU thread.

The post Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance
item.description:
CopilotKit released OpenBot 1.0, an MIT-licensed, self-hostable AI coworker workspace. Companies bring their own agents, models and infrastructure, while every Bot action passes a policy check and lands in an audit trail.

The post CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: AWS Releases AWS Emulator: A Local Copy of 200+ AWS Services Built by AI Agents
item.description:
AWS released AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local emulator of AWS APIs built from 438 API models. Autonomous agents wrote all of its code. It passes 56.6% of 42,857 published fidelity tests at launch.

The post AWS Releases AWS Emulator: A Local Copy of 200+ AWS Services Built by AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: IBM Announces IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3: A New Processor to Support 10k Quantum Operations on 520 Programmable Qubits
item.description:
IBM announced Quantum Nighthawk r3, a 520-qubit processor designed for 10,000 quantum operations. 2 r3 chips will link into a 1,040-qubit system in 2027, while Nighthawk r2 already posts up to 19x speedups over Heron.

The post IBM Announces IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3: A New Processor to Support 10k Quantum Operations on 520 Programmable Qubits appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API With Gemini Decision 1 at $0.10/M Tokens
item.description:
Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1. It returns calibrated probabilities for up to 1,000 yes/no, choice and rubric questions over text, images, audio, video and PDFs, at $0.10 per 1M input tokens.

The post Google Launches Gemini Decisions API With Gemini Decision 1 at $0.10/M Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome 2 for Cell-Type-Specific Variant Effects
item.description:
Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, a conditional DNA sequence model that predicts regulatory activity and variant effects per cell type. It is available via the AlphaGenome API for non-commercial research.

The post Google DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome 2 for Cell-Type-Specific Variant Effects appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
item.description:
The Institute of Foundation Models at MBZUAI released PAN 2, an Apache 2.0 world model that couples an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video.

The post MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI appeared first on MarkTechPost.
